blurb: Huntington Academy of Dance offers dance classes for all ages and disciplines including ballet, tap, jazz, lyrical, contemporary, musical theater, and more. They have performing groups that participate in local and national events and a resident youth ballet company called Ballet Etudes. The academy also offers studio rentals for rehearsals and teaching.
extraNote: Monthly tuition due first lesson of the month; $10 late fee after 10th; $25 fee for returned checks · No credits, refunds, or adjustments for missed lessons · Drop off and pick up parking rules to ensure safety
